name: @aise/solution-contract
description: AISE interactive solution graph and engineering operation contract (PROD-021, SHARED): versioned, domain-extensible wire objects for the interactive engineering solution workflow (Solution, SolutionVersion, EngineeringOperation, EngineeringOperationIntent, ProposedState, OperationDependency, OperationTarget, OperationEffect, SolutionValidationSnapshot, solution-to-BOQ trace objects, domain descriptor, operation capability negotiation) per ACR-005/ACR-006. Data + contract logic only — no I/O in the core, no server behavior, no 3D, no agent implementation, NO MUTATION PATH FOR AUTHORITATIVE REALITY (proposals stay separate from observed reality).
